title: User Authentication and Authorization
aim: Implement user authentication and authorization (Login/Registration) using Express.js, MongoDB, and AI coding assistants.

procedure.action: User registration with name/email/password, login, GET /api/auth/me, admin-only user listing and deletion.
The AI generates auth routes, bcrypt hashing logic, JWT token issuance, and protected React UI.
Email is unique and lowercased; password is stored strictly as bcrypt passwordHash; role is 'user' or 'admin'.
Validates inputs, rejects duplicate emails with HTTP 409, hashes password (cost 10), returns safe user object and JWT.
Looks up user, verifies password with bcrypt.compare, signs a 2-hour JWT with HS256 algorithm.
requireAuth parses Authorization: Bearer <token>; requireRole('admin') blocks unauthorized access with 403 Forbidden.

prompt:
Implement authentication and authorization for an Express.js + MongoDB API.

MODEL — User
- name: required, max 60
- email: required, unique, lowercase, validated
- passwordHash: required, select: false
- role: "user" | "admin", default "user"
- timestamps

ROUTES
- POST /api/auth/register { name, email, password, role } -> hash with bcrypt, return 201 { user, token }
- POST /api/auth/login { email, password } -> compare hash, return { user, token }; invalid credentials -> 401
- GET /api/auth/me -> requires valid Bearer token
- GET /api/users -> admin only; non-admin receives 403 Forbidden

SECURITY RULES
- Passwords only stored as bcrypt hashes (cost 10).
- JWT signed with JWT_SECRET, expires in 2h.
- Never expose passwordHash in API responses.
- Seed demo accounts on boot for demonstration.

UI
- Login / Register tabs, inline field errors, Bearer token stored in state, profile panel, and admin user table.
